title: Recognizing and preventing banking scams - explained
content: Bank impersonation scams often pressure people to share secrets, install remote-access software or authorize an unexplained payment. Independently verify contact details and use trusted banking channels; legitimate support should not require you to disclose a PIN, OTP, CVV or password.
